{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Grampa Canyon |characters=グランパキャニオン |japanese=Grampa Canyon |image=Grandpa Canyon.png |imagesize=250px |region=Kanto |epicode=EP046 |episode=Attack of the Prehistoric Pokémon }} '''Grampa Canyon''' (Japanese: '''グランパキャニオン''' ''Grampa Canyon'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kanto]]. It is found right outside of [[Neon Town]] and is located between the {{safari|Kanto}} and [[Cinnabar Island]]. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were traveling through the canyon in ''[[EP046|Attack of the Prehistoric Pokémon]]'', they learned that some ancient Pokémon [[Fossil]]s were found recently. Along with {{Gary}}, the kids began digging in the canyon to look for the Fossils. Meanwhile, {{TRT}} had planned to blow up the entire canyon to collect the Fossils with dynamite, which would have placed several innocent bystanders in mortal danger. Thanks to Team Rocket, Ash and {{AP|Pikachu}} ended up in a hidden cavern found in the canyon. There, they found that five extinct Pokémon were living alive and well. They weren't happy about being disturbed, and eventually an {{p|Aerodactyl}} lifted Ash out of the cave. He was saved by his {{p|Charmeleon}} [[Evolution|evolving]] into {{AP|Charizard}} and [[Pokémon battle|battling]] it. As a result of the entire incident, paleontological work for finding any Pokémon Fossils was shut down indefinitely. In addition to the ancient Pokémon, Ash also found an {{pkmn|Egg}} in the canyon.
